children: Shares of ProCap Financial were higher after the company said it will be included in the small-cap Russell 2000 Index and the broad-market Russell 3000 Index, effective for trading at the U.S. market open Monday.
The stock was 3.8% higher, at $3.57, but has fallen 65% in the past 12 months.
The company said Wednesday that its corporate entity will be renamed Silvia Inc., and will begin trading under the ticker SVIA, effective Tuesday.
